name: Google Chrome DevContainer
postStartCommand: mkdir -p ~/.chrome-data && docker system prune -f 2>/dev/null || true; docker rm -f chrome 2>/dev/null || true; docker run -d --name=chrome --restart=always -p 8080:3000 -v /home/vscode/.chrome-data:/config -e AUTO_LOGIN=true -e SUBFOLDER=/ -e CHROME_CLI="--disable-dev-shm-usage --disable-gpu --no-sandbox" --security-opt seccomp=unconfined --shm-size=4gb ghcr.io/linuxserver/chrome:latest
